enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Fortification +111%: +111% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.

Greater Disease Guard: This item carries the Maggot Plague disease, which deals 2d6 Constitution damage and may be contracted by enemies that hit you. A successful Fortitude Save (DC 28) will negate this effect.
Sheltering +24: +24 Enhancement bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings
Demonic Shield: Each time you are hit in melee combat there is a chance that a shield of demonic energy will grant you a +30 Profane bonus to temporary hit points.
Damage Reduction 15/Good: Reduces physical damage by 15, except from Good attacks.
Spell Resistance +28: +28 Enhancement bonus to Spell Resistance.
